name: General Physician
description: Evaluates common illnesses, performs initial assessment, and coordinates referrals when needed.

name: Cardiologist
description: Focuses on heart and blood vessel conditions such as chest pain, hypertension, and palpitations.

name: Pulmonologist
description: Specializes in lung and breathing disorders including asthma, chronic cough, and shortness of breath.

name: ENT Specialist
description: Treats ear, nose, and throat conditions including sore throat, sinus issues, cough, and ear pain.

name: Dermatologist
description: Manages skin, hair, and nail conditions including rashes, acne, and eczema.

name: Gastroenterologist
description: Evaluates digestive system symptoms such as abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.

name: Neurologist
description: Assesses nervous system symptoms including headache, dizziness, numbness, and vision changes.

name: Orthopedist
description: Treats bone, joint, and musculoskeletal pain including back pain and joint injuries.

name: Urologist
description: Manages urinary tract and male reproductive system conditions.

name: Gynecologist
description: Provides care for female reproductive health and related urinary symptoms when appropriate.

name: Ophthalmologist
description: Evaluates eye conditions and vision problems.

name: Dentist
description: Treats tooth pain, gum disease, and oral health concerns.

name: Pediatrician
description: Provides medical care for infants, children, and adolescents.

name: Psychiatrist
description: Evaluates mental health conditions including anxiety and mood disorders.
